# Endless recursion over the type graph at a top-level: the top-level is a
# nullable union whose member is an array of the union itself, so
# directlyReachableTypes (the default namedTypeToNameForTopLevel) recurses
# until V8's stack overflows, a RangeError, before any renderer code runs
# (support::recursion::guard in Rust). A separate scenario from
# recursion-overflow.txt, whose graph has the cycle below a class.
input schema TopLevel {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"$ref": "#"}}
